authority: Latest user requests following Astra Max review; no repeated approval for this bounded first comparison
claim_scope: Effect of graph-wide versus connected-component-wide summary on innerdev32 B prediction; not physical FE topology repair or AC accuracy
phase_selection_rule: electrical only if all three-seed A2 improvement and no-harm gates PASS; otherwise mechanical. Apply the same selected encoding to both C/G arms. Do not choose based on a single seed.

C.definition: area-weighted mean hidden state within the native-edge connected component

G.definition: area-weighted mean hidden state across the same physical graph

same_in_both_arms: Frozen native graph with a2 excluded
Same backbone initial tensor state per seed
Physical area-weighted B MSE, no prior/AC/paired loss
Optimizer, update-indexed LR, data order and final checkpoint only

engineering_gates.CPU_contract: Same initialization/parameter count; W0 exact original backbone outputs; no cross-batch pooling; nonzeroW graph-context derivative across native components and zero component-context derivative
engineering_gates.native_input: 360 admitted cases' component IDs from native edge_index only; source/selection/ID/edge hashes; no B-derived input
engineering_gates.overfit: Fixed train case40 step0, both scopes, 1500 updates each; finite loss/gradient and finalMSE<=0.1*initialMSE. Engineering-path gate only, not field accuracy qualification. Do not extend if failed.
engineering_gates.GPU_smoke_profile: Fixed one-A0-epoch equivalent2957 updates per scope seed17, isolated outputs; finite gradients/outputs, soft memory gate and completed resource projection with immutable code/inputs; no smoke weights reused
engineering_gates.wall_projection: Measured profile must project completion of six full fixed runs plus evaluation/collection inside the remaining6h envelope before launching full runs
engineering_gates.evaluator_restore: CPU synthetic C/G serialization exact with nonzero W and rejection of arm/scope mismatch; same checked loader used by frozen evaluator

evaluation.primary: Same original L12 area-weighted B-vector nRMSE on all45
evaluation.common_native_a1_Arkkio: Separate pinned common-evaluation extension; no air-as-a1 fallback or independent-final-test claim

decision_rule.missing_failed: INCOMPLETE_NO_CLAIM; no seed replacement or per-arm deletion

execution.STOP: stage or owned run STOP; PID+create_time guarded tree only

source_cost: Same328 train+32dev historical Full conditions, deduplicated; new Full0. Report incremental preparation/training/inference work separately. Current dev32 is E1 oldTRAIN exposed.
